To record and follow up on workplace injuries and near misses, a small business can maintain a simple incident log. The log should be used to record all incidents, including the date, location, description of what happened, any injuries sustained, immediate response, and any contributing factors. The business should ensure that staff report incidents promptly and that the log is reviewed regularly to identify any necessary follow-up actions. By documenting incidents and near misses, the business can identify areas for improvement and take steps to prevent future incidents.
